caption: The drawing consists of two rectangular sections, each containing a distinct pattern, centered on a plain beige or light tan background. The top rectangle is composed of a grid of nine squares, each outlined in a light line, containing a brownish mauve fill and a simple black swirl design inside every square. The bottom rectangle is filled with a solid dark blue color and is decorated with ten evenly spaced white stars, each outlined in red. Below the bottom rectangle, the name "Mary G. Davidson" is written in small, neat lettering. The two rectangles are separated by a space and are aligned vertically along the center of the page.
title: Printed Swatches
